published_files.name: metadata.parquet
published_files.role: official recommended metadata excluding patches covered by seasonal snow, cloud, or cloud shadow

published_files.name: metadata_for_patches_with_snow_cloud_or_shadow.parquet
published_files.role: official metadata for excluded contamination cases

published_files.name: Reference_Maps.tar.zst
published_files.role: pixel-level CLC2018 reference maps; not required for the Phase 4 classification task

fields.patch_id: Sentinel-2 v2 patch identifier and primary patch key
fields.labels: list of 19-class CLC2018 v2020_u1 land-cover labels
fields.split: official train, validation, or test assignment
fields.s1_name: corresponding Sentinel-1 patch identifier; authoritative S1-to-S2 pairing field
fields.s2v1_name: corresponding BigEarthNet v1 Sentinel-2 patch identifier

official_metadata_contract.pairing_rule: Use patch_id -> s1_name only; never derive a pair from filename similarity or acquisition time.

official_geographical_split.algorithm: Per Sentinel-2 tile: outer frame is train, inner frame is validation, innermost square is test.
official_geographical_split.leakage_control: The official construction places same-season overlaps at adjacent Sentinel-2 tile borders in train and increases distance between train and test.
official_geographical_split.policy: SatQuery must retain the official assignment as the outer split and must not reshuffle patches across it.
official_geographical_split.count_verification: Verified in Phase 4B from the checksum-verified clean metadata file; counts were not inferred from the multi-label class-distribution table.

quality_and_exclusions.sentinel_2_processing: Level-2A bottom-of-atmosphere surface reflectance generated with sen2cor 2.11
quality_and_exclusions.invalid_pixels: Patches containing invalid pixels were removed during v2 construction.
quality_and_exclusions.insufficient_labels: Patches with no labels or with less than 75% reference-map label coverage were removed during v2 construction.
quality_and_exclusions.seasonal_snow_cloud_shadow: These cases remain in the imagery archives but are separated into the dedicated metadata file.
quality_and_exclusions.phase4_policy: Select only rows from metadata.parquet; do not infer cloud quality from pixels and do not include rows from the contamination metadata file.

file_and_geospatial_organization.hierarchy: sensor archive -> source tile/scene directory -> patch directory -> one GeoTIFF per band or polarization
file_and_geospatial_organization.georeferencing: Each band/polarization is a georeferenced GeoTIFF; the v2 patches preserve the same 1200 m x 1200 m footprints used for the corresponding BigEarthNet patches.
file_and_geospatial_organization.random_access_constraint: The canonical S1 and S2 distributions are monolithic tar.zst archives, not a documented per-patch object store. A logical subset therefore may still require downloading both full archives unless an official selective-access path is verified.

source_discrepancies.detail: The current BigEarthNet homepage and Zenodo 2.0.0 record state 115 tiles. The reBEN paper's construction narrative says 125 input tiles and six quality-check exclusions (119), while the homepage FAQ separately mentions four v1 tiles dropped. This audit uses the current release record value and treats metadata.patch_id, not a reconstructed tile count, as authoritative for selection.

audit_limitations: No imagery archive was downloaded or opened in Phase 4A.
Phase 4B verified metadata only; no imagery archive was opened.
Archive checksums are the publisher-provided MD5 values; Phase 4B must verify them if full archives are acquired.
